typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		TRACKING_ID as string,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID as string,
		FORM_TYPE as string,
		BILL_TYPE as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		{CLAIM_ REASON} as string,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID as string,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID as string,
		PAT_CTRL_NUM as string,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT as string,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		CLAIM_START_DT as string,
		CLAIM_END_DT as string,
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT as string,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM as string,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE as string,
		MOD_CODE1 as string,
		MOD_CODE2 as string,
		REV_CODE as string,
		SERV_UNITS as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SRCFFVendorInboundFiles
SRCFFVendorInboundFiles derive(CLAIM_START_DT_Chk = iif(length(CLAIM_START_DT) == 8, (substring(toString(CLAIM_START_DT), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(CLAIM_START_DT), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(CLAIM_START_DT), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), CLAIM_START_DT),
		CLAIM_END_DT_Chk = iif(length(CLAIM_END_DT) == 8, (substring(toString(CLAIM_END_DT), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(CLAIM_END_DT), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(CLAIM_END_DT), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), CLAIM_END_DT),
		DATA_SOURCE = iif(iif(iif(locate('EyeM', $VendFileFullName, 1) > 0, 'EyeMed', locate('DentQ', $VendFileFullName, 1) > 0), 'DentaQuest', locate('LibertyDen', $VendFileFullName, 1) > 0), 'LibertyDental', ''),
		Rundate = currentTimestamp(),
		RunLogID = $RunLogID,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean = iif(length(trim(replace(replace(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT, toString('\r'), toString('')), toString('\n'), toString('')))) == 0, toString(null()), trim(replace(replace(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT, toString('\r'), toString('')), toString('\n'), toString(''))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(CLAIM_END_DT_Date = toDate(toString(CLAIM_END_DT_Chk, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT} = toInteger(CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT),
		{Copy of CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean} = toInteger(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean),
		CLAIM_START_DT_Date = toDate(toString(CLAIM_START_DT_Chk, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		RunLogID as integer,
		CLAIM_REASON as string,
		DATA_SOURCE as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT as integer,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM as integer,
		SERV_UNITS as integer,
		CLAIM_START_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PAT_CTRL_NUM as string,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID as string,
		REV_CODE as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		MOD_CODE2 as string,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE as string,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID as string,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		FORM_TYPE as string,
		MOD_CODE1 as string,
		TRACKING_ID as string,
		BILL_TYPE as string,
		CLAIM_END_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT as integer,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID as string,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		RunLogID,
		CLAIM_REASON = {CLAIM_ REASON},
		DATA_SOURCE,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT = {Copy of CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean},
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM,
		SERV_UNITS,
		CLAIM_START_DT = CLAIM_START_DT_Date,
		PAT_CTRL_NUM,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID,
		REV_CODE,
		CLAIM_STATUS,
		MOD_CODE2,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE,
		FORM_TYPE,
		MOD_CODE1,
		TRACKING_ID,
		BILL_TYPE,
		CLAIM_END_DT = CLAIM_END_DT_Date,
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT = {Copy of CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT})) ~> OLEDBOHCHPendedPaidClaimsState
